pages.text: Press $(k:origins.view_origin) to see your origin. Origins is the framework that runs IridescentCraft's whole class and race system.

$(bold)Role in the pack:$() Origins provides the selection UI and the power system. Every class and race ability is an Origins power, defined in the pack's own datapacks.$(br2)$(bold)Selection:$() You are asked to pick a Race and a Class when you first join a world. If you miss it, press $(k:origins.view_origin). Your primary origin power fires on $(k:origins.primary_active).

$(bold)Limitations:$() Origins powers are applied at selection. If your class or race seems broken after a pack update, the $(bold)/origin set$() command (yours in singleplayer, an admin's on the server) re-applies it.$(br2)$(bold)Race is permanent.$() To respec your class, use the Class Altar.$(br2)$(bold)Next: pick yours in $(l:icraft:welcome/class_guide)Origin, Race & Class$(/l).$()
